name: @compass/docs-migrate
description: One-shot sanitization migration for the engineering-docs corpus (SEA-1766). Strips four classes of private-origin artifacts from design records moving into this public repo — linear.app tracker links (both forms) to bare SEA-#### IDs, `oss/compass/` path prefixes, links to private seal-*.md records (de-linked to prose) — while keeping security sections verbatim. Deleted at the end of the corpus migration (T5); not a standing check.
